turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
I didn't come in with anything but a question. You haven't answered it.
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.

Flattery of her again. Bat it away; mention the principal is next anyway.

The principal's office is my next stop. Who decided, Hale?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?

"Between us" is a pressure move; she refuses it, cold, and goes back to her question. Short.

Nothing here is between us. Answer the question.
